legal_units.title: Stay of proceedings in pursuance of certificate and amendment or cancellation thereof.
legal_units.text: The Tax Recovery Officer may grant time for the payment of any tax and, till the expiry of such time, shall stay the recovery proceedings for such tax.

legal_units.title: Stay of proceedings in pursuance of certificate and amendment or cancellation thereof.
legal_units.text: Where a certificate has been drawn up and subsequently, the amount of the outstanding demand is reduced as a result of the order giving rise to the said demand, being modified in an appeal or other proceeding under this Act, the Tax Recovery Officer shall—

Section 415(2): Where a certificate has been drawn up and subsequently, the amount of the outstanding demand is reduced as a result of the order giving rise to the said demand, being modified in an appeal or other proceeding under this Act, the Tax Recovery Officer shall—
